# Local modifications to selected Tau Ceti source

All selected originals come from commit `3358033ba2fd35f321356dceaf2372a0fd6c0bfd`; SOURCE_MAP.json records exact source hashes. Unified patches reproduce every active implementation and native split. DECLARATION_MAP.json records per-declaration origins and detailed changes.

- Remove Lean 4.34 module/public syntax for the repository's pinned Lean 4.33.1 environment; do not change the dependency/toolchain pins. Preserve original copyright headers and selected declaration documentation.
- Equal-dimensional Sard keeps the established `MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_fderivWithin` name and signature. Construct the source Borel structure locally and inline the adapted Haar measure transport proof from `MeasureTheory/Measure/Haar/NormedSpace.lean`. Leave native full Sard and locally Lipschitz regular-value results in their mathematical home.
- Morse genericity exposes selected derivative-bijectivity engines under `TauCeti`, without introducing competing critical-point or Morse definitions. Its dual-dimension helper adapts the finite-dimension source recorded in the map. Native Hessian conversion and the three existing public theorem names remain in `Topology/Morse/Generic`.
- The slice-chart proof keeps the existing `Manifold.IsImmersionAtOfComplement.exists_contMDiffOn_slice_chart` API, native pinned Mathlib immersion charts, source corners and a boundaryless ambient model. Extract its original immersion-coordinate identity and smoothness calculation into shared external lemmas. Both local and parameterized native extension proofs now consume those lemmas. The smooth-embedding corollary and all native extension/gluing theorems remain native.
- Upstream umbrella definitions, unused declarations, unsupported embedding vocabulary, examples and unrelated dependency modules are not copied into the active library. The archive preserves the selected complete original source files for attribution and exact comparison.
